patterns.note: Split-screen hero layout pairing a vibrant, abstract golden-orange gradient on the left with a warm, sun-drenched photographic portrait on the right.
A comforting, sunset-inspired palette transitioning from deep chocolate brown to radiant golden yellow, accented by a contrasting sky-blue banner.
Scroll-driven SVG path drawing where a golden circular arc traces its outline as the user scrolls, paired with scroll-linked opacity fades on section headers.
Massive, pill-shaped container cards with ultra-soft, oversized corner radiuses that frame full-width content blocks like the sky banner and FAQ section.

technique_notes: To recreate the motion system, use GSAP ScrollTrigger to link the scroll progress directly to the stroke-dashoffset of the circular SVG paths, creating the drawing effect. Simultaneously, bind scroll depth to the opacity of split-text characters or words to create the smooth, progressive text reveals. For the testimonial carousel, implement Swiper.js with a custom CSS transform that applies a slight rotation and perspective to the non-active cards, mimicking a physical fan of cards.

design_tokens.type_scale: Warm, editorial serif headings (~4x body size) paired with clean, highly legible geometric sans-serif body copy and small, widely-spaced metadata.
design_tokens.radius: rounded — extremely generous, pill-like corner radiuses on major section containers, contrasted with fully pill-shaped buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — exceptionally spacious vertical padding and generous margins that give the circular motifs and large typography immense breathing room.

standout: The design beautifully translates the concept of 'Dawn' through a soothing, sunset-to-sunrise color gradient and a scroll-driven golden arc that mimics the rising sun, creating an incredibly calming user experience perfect for a mental health platform.
